entities.summary: Gopi Krishna was an Indian yogi, mystic, teacher, social reformer, and writer. He was one of the first to popularise the concept of kundalini among Western readers. His autobiography Kundalini: The Evolutionary Energy in Man, which presented his personal account of the phenomenon of his awakening of kundalini,, was published in Great Britain and the United States and has since appeared in eleven major languages. According to June McDaniel, his writings have influenced Western interest in kundalini yoga.
